answer_4.quote: We generate 200 paraphrases with each model using MRPC corpus, and ask six Mechanical Turk workers to evaluate whether each paraphrase is (1) fluent, (2) faithful to the source, and (3) dissimilar to the source
answer_4.guideline: Workers used a 3-point Likert scale to evaluate fluency, faithfulness, and dissimilarity for paraphrases, and fluency, faithfulness, and conciseness for summaries.
